verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's CUDA Toolkit page documents a full compute toolchain: compiler, runtime, libraries, CUDA Tile C++/cuTile Python and Nsight profilers. The RTX 50 Series page says developers get GPU-optimized SDKs and PyTorch and other inference backends on RTX AI PCs. However, no cited doc explicitly lists the RTX 5070 Ti (or its Blackwell compute capability) as a supported CUDA target, so support is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: an explicit CUDA supported-GPU or compute-capability listing for the 5070 Ti, and hands-on or independent evidence of compute workloads running on it.
